title: Eval run logging
one_line: Log eval cases as records, or import inspect-ai and lm-eval results.
verified_against: EvalRun and the inspect-ai / lm-eval parsers tested on log files stored in tests/fixtures. Not run against output from a current inspect-ai or lm-eval release.
snippet:
from briefcase.integrations.evals import EvalRun

with EvalRun("gsm8k", model="my-model") as run:
    run.log_case("q1", inputs="2+2", outputs="4", passed=True)
print(run.summary())
